premise: Rising from the chess clubs of southern India to become the undisputed World Chess Champion.
hook: He learned the rules of chess from his mother at age six in a house without a computer or grandmaster coach.
key_facts: Became India's first international chess grandmaster in 1988 at the age of 18
Won the FIDE World Chess Championship in 2000, becoming the first Indian to hold the title
Defended and retained the world championship title in 2007, 2008, 2010, and 2012
Awarded India's highest civilian sporting honor, the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, in 1991

premise: Starting Infosys with just $250 borrowed from his wife and a vision to build a global software giant in India.
hook: He launched one of the world's biggest tech companies from his living room using borrowed money from his wife.
key_facts: Co-founded Infosys in Pune, India, in 1981.
Started with a modest capital of 10,000 rupees.
Pioneered the global delivery model for software services.
Served as CEO for over two decades, transforming India's tech landscape.

premise: Resigning as India's Defence Minister immediately after the 1962 war defeat to accept full political accountability.
hook: Instead of defending his department after a military defeat, he took full responsibility on national television.
key_facts: Served as India's Defence Minister during the 1962 Sino-Indian War
Succeeded V. K. Krishna Menon in the cabinet following the conflict
Navigated the transition of leadership during the deaths of Nehru and Shastri
Later served as India's Home Minister and Finance Minister

premise: Pawned his wife's jewelry and used his own life savings to finish filming Pather Panchali after running out of money.
hook: His masterpiece film was paused for nearly three years because nobody believed a slow-paced art film about rural Bengal would sell.
key_facts: Worked as a commercial artist while struggling to finance his directorial debut.
Shot the film intermittently on weekends whenever funds became available.
Received partial financial intervention from the Government of West Bengal to complete production.
Pather Panchali won Best Human Document at the 1956 Cannes Film Festival.

premise: Journeying from a small town in Haryana to becoming the first Indian-born woman in space.
hook: Growing up in a conservative Indian town where engineering was rarely pursued by women, she dreamed only of the stars.
key_facts: Graduated with an aeronautical engineering degree from Punjab Engineering College.
Moved to the United States in 1982 to earn her master's and doctorate in aerospace engineering.
Selected by NASA in 1994 and flew on Space Shuttle Columbia in 1997.

premise: Surviving months stranded on the Antarctic ice after his ship was crushed in the pack ice.
hook: His ship was completely destroyed by icebergs, leaving his entire crew stranded on floating ice floes with no way to communicate with the outside world.
key_facts: Led the Imperial Trans-Antarctic Expedition in 1914 aboard the ship Endurance.
Watched the Endurance sink after being trapped and crushed by Weddell Sea ice in 1915.
Successfully navigated an open lifeboat 800 miles across stormy seas to South Georgia Island to secure rescue.
